deliverable: Admission no longer sleeps one second per admit to measure swap-out: measurePressure in admission.ts reuses the previous pswpout reading for the same procRoot (kept in module memory with the injected clock's time) when it is at least 1 s and at most 60 s old, computing pages per second from it with no sleep; only when there is no usable previous reading does it take the two samples one second apart as today. Every reading updates the remembered sample. Tests use createManualClock and a fake procRoot.
acceptance: a second admit within 60 s of the first computes swap-out from the remembered reading without sleeping
a remembered reading under 1 s old or over 60 s old is not used and the two-sample measurement runs
readings for different procRoots are kept apart
the reported swap rate equals the pswpout delta divided by the elapsed seconds
